# Vibe Voyager — Project CLAUDE.md

## Project
Interactive space exploration game teaching vibe coding, agentic AI, and modern SE practices.
URL: [REDACTED_DOMAIN] | Hosting: Vercel free tier | Deadline: ~2026-03-14

## Stack
- Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 (@import "tailwindcss", @theme directive)
- Motion (`motion` package, import from `motion/react` — NOT framer-motion)
- HTML5 Canvas (star map, mini-games)
- Howler.js (ambient audio + SFX sprites)
- localStorage (game save state — no backend)

## Design System
- Style: Clean minimalist sci-fi (glassmorphism, parallax, SVG planets)
- Void: #0a0f1a | Nebula Blue: #4a6fa5 | Signal Green: #6b9e78
- Core Terracotta: #c17147 | Starlight: #e8e0d4 | Glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.05)
- Fonts: Space Grotesk (display), Inter (body), JetBrains Mono (code)
- Panels: backdrop-blur + thin border glow. Framer spring animations on all transitions.

## Key Files
- `BUILD_LOG.md` — Update after every major milestone (tracks build process for meta section)
- `sources.md` — 57+ curated links, primary content source
- Memory files at `~/.claude/projects/-Users-shehral-vibe/memory/` — consult before each session

## Memory References
- `memory/project-overview.md` — narrative arc, audience, metaphors
- `memory/tech-stack.md` — full stack details, colors, typography
- `memory/game-systems.md` — stats, ranks, missions, crew, inventory
- `memory/content-mapping.md` — every planet, every mission, content sources
- `memory/user-preferences.md` — build style, hosting, timeline

## Game Structure
3 Acts + Epilogue. 8 planets. 34 missions. 5 crew members. 4 player stats. 10 Academy sections.
See memory/game-systems.md and memory/content-mapping.md for full details.

## Rules
- ALWAYS check context7 for latest Motion/Next.js/Tailwind v4 APIs before writing components.
- All game state in localStorage — no backend, no database, no auth.
- Academy section accessible from title screen WITHOUT playing the game.
- Update BUILD_LOG.md after completing each major feature (for the meta case study).
